versions.changelog:
Initial release: step-by-step setup guide for connecting and controlling Android phones via ClawPaw.

- Guides users through prerequisites, APK install, permissions, SSH tunnel, ADB, and end-to-end tests.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common setup errors.
- Automates device and permission checks using included Bash scripts.
- Supports MCP integration for advanced remote phone controls from Claude Code.
